scope: isolated default-off SQLite durable Cursor→job→Slack-resume lane
disclaimer: SQLite is not PostgreSQL. Injected fakes are not sandbox E2E. This is local component/integration evidence only — not live Slack, not live Cursor, not gateway ingress, not production control plane.
external_blockers: PostgreSQL durable store, advisory locks, and SERIALIZABLE isolation (ENG-25) — never claimed from SQLite IMMEDIATE
Sandbox E2E against live Cursor or live Slack
Gateway ingress, production state.db, deploy, service restart, credentials, order mutation

rows.title: before/after immutable job/package commit
rows.notes: after_job_rows_before_commit seam. Crash-before-commit leaves 0 jobs/events. Duplicate idempotency adopts. SQLite rollback is not PostgreSQL.

rows.title: before decision and Go persist/consume
rows.notes: after_decision_rows_before_commit. Uncommitted Go cannot be consumed; ENG-29 claim still requires accepted Go. Default no-op fault-injection seams cannot authorize or bypass.

rows.title: concurrent Go/Hold/Cancel and crash during consume+claim
rows.notes: Cancel is terminal. os._exit during after_in_transaction_adapter_go leaves zero claims. Not a live adapter RPC abort.

rows.title: effect claim before provider create
rows.notes: Zero provider create without bound Go. Characterization of existing claim-before-create plus ENG-29 deny.

rows.title: accepted-lost provider create plus timeout/5xx/busy; lookup/adopt or PROVIDER_AMBIGUOUS; never blind retry
rows.notes: http_5xx and busy are parametrized on isolated temp job/action/store. Lookup-first; create_calls==1 each. Stateful fake only. Live Cursor timeout/5xx/busy is BLOCKED_EXTERNAL.

rows.title: response before correlation commit; mismatch/orphan fail closed
rows.notes: Accepted create without run_id is ORPHAN_RESPONSE. cursor: key mismatch is CORRELATION_MISMATCH. No mapping bind.

rows.title: duplicate ingress/concurrent dispatch/restart one job/effect
rows.notes: Reopen ledger does not call create_run again. Threads are not OS processes (see row 19).

rows.title: poll transient + missing/multiple/wrong lookup bounded retry then typed Hold
rows.notes: Empty lookup stays RECOVERING until recovery_deadline then UNKNOWN+Hold. Wrong-key lookup is PROVIDER_AMBIGUOUS+Hold. Never blind retry.

rows.title: cancellation ambiguity reconciliation
rows.notes: In-flight create cannot be aborted by SQLite; success CAS includes Cancel predicate so bind cannot overwrite Cancel. Crash-before-commit Cancel is atomic.

rows.title: Slack root intent before send
rows.notes: CLAIMED is durable before post_root. Fake Slack port only.

rows.title: accepted-lost root/status adopt or REMOTE_DELIVERY_AMBIGUOUS
rows.notes: AMBIGUOUS_LOOKUP aliases REMOTE_DELIVERY_AMBIGUOUS. Live Slack lookup is BLOCKED_EXTERNAL.

rows.title: root accepted before durable bind; no cross bind
rows.notes: BindingRequiredError before post. UNIQUE (workspace, channel, root) rejects cross-job bind.

rows.title: duplicate/stale/cross-job/workspace actions and ACK-before-decision-commit
rows.notes: decision_idempotency_key reuse is bound to the persisted inbound tuple. Mismatch rejects with zero ACK/decision mutation. Two-process UNIQUE race reloads the winner. coordinator.consume_inbound_action is a local SQLite seam, not gateway Slack action routing.

rows.title: terminal evidence commit/checkpoint
rows.notes: Evidence requires matching ACCEPTED/ADOPTED provider_run_id or DELIVERED/ADOPTED Slack ts. No COMPLETE without it.

rows.title: terminal evidence before resume enqueue; accepted enqueue before local mark; stable idempotency key
rows.notes: Stable key resume:{job_id}:{evidence_id}. CHECK forbids local_marked unless status=accepted. Not a live Slack resume enqueue.

rows.title: delivery lease/sink accepted-lost/ACK-before-delivered; fail-closed/at-least-once
rows.notes: Slack root delivery lease is the supported production seam (claim before post, lost→adopt). Generic non-Slack delivery sink is BLOCKED_MISSING_SEAM — not invented. Live Slack is BLOCKED_EXTERNAL.

rows.title: exact lease expiry and clock changes
rows.notes: claim_is_expired uses <=. Per-ledger ClockWatermark refuses rewind. Not NTP, not distributed clocks, not PostgreSQL.

rows.title: restart each supported nonterminal state executes only persisted permitted next_action
rows.notes: Package 1 phases INTAKE/FREEZE_BASELINE/AWAIT_DISPATCH only. Dispatch remains hard-disabled. Tampered next_action is RestartDenied.

rows.title: real OS-process contention for effect/resume/delivery single winner where supported by SQLite
rows.notes: Two real CPython processes vs one SQLite file with BEGIN IMMEDIATE. Not PostgreSQL advisory locks, not sandbox multi-replica. SQLite is not PostgreSQL.

rows.title: datastore unavailable/locked/full and transaction failure no partial mutation
rows.notes: SQLite writer lock, injected disk-full seam, and mid-transaction crash rollback are proven locally. PostgreSQL unavailable/SERIALIZABLE/tablespace-full is BLOCKED_EXTERNAL.

rows.title: unknown policy/version/schema/pruned data default-deny and key nonreuse
rows.notes: Empty DB may initialize. Pre-existing durable-jobs schema/data missing schema_version raises UnknownSchemaError before DDL or stamp. Malformed/future versions also refuse without mutation. prune_authorization_tuple retires the idempotency key. ENG-29 unknown actions still default-deny.

rows.title: logs/events redact tokens/prompts and preserve correlation IDs
rows.notes: durable_job_events payload redacts token/prompt/authorization keys. job_id and event idempotency_key columns are preserved.
